finding.description: Overlapping beginLogin publications can orphan a committed generation's physical credentials after the winning tab logs out.
finding.reproduction: B captures G, pauses before publishing B; A publishes and commits A; B resumes and purges only captured G. A's authority check merely revokes its lease. B logout removes B but leaves A credential material, its committed marker and no A tombstone.
finding.impact: Ordinary reload remains locked on B, but the old bearer/refresh credential remains in localStorage and pointer restoration adopts it locally. Live token acceptance was not tested.
finding.required_fix: Clean superseded credential generations without relying on old-tab responsiveness and without removing a genuinely newer generation. Add the interleaving as a production-adapter regression.

finding.description: A length snapshot plus live key(index) enumeration can miss a retired credential when another tab removes an earlier key and shifts the key list.
finding.reproduction: Logout enumerates retired X; another tab removes X; retired Y shifts below the next index. Logout completes but leaves Y credential/committed marker without its tombstone. No crash or refused storage operation is required.
finding.required_fix: Replace mutable indexed enumeration with a defensible key-name snapshot while preserving strict namespace and current-generation checks; add the exact concurrent-removal regression.
